title: Persona 5 Royal Costs You 17¢ an Hour. Worth It?
caption:
Persona 5 Royal is $17.99 on Steam right now (70% off $59.99) and the main story takes about 105 hours (HowLongToBeat): 17¢ an hour. Full price is 57¢ an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Our own math.
Which game should we price next?

Sources: Steam store (US price, 28 Nov), HowLongToBeat
ig_first_line: Send this to the friend with 300 hours in Persona 5 Royal: it's $17.99 right now, 17¢ an hour.
